tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find Nas House articles by keywords (for example "day pass price", "garden event capacity", "check-in time"). Returns up to `limit` matching articles with slug, summary, topic, dates and URLs, best match first. Start here; then call get_article with a slug to read one in full.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one article, chosen by slug from search_articles or list_topics. Also reads the site pages "pricing" (published prices in AED), "contact", "about" and "privacy". Use this after you know which document you need; use search_articles when you only have keywords.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every topic (Stay, Membership and coworking, Events, Retreats, Health, Dubai guides) with its description, article count and the slugs and titles of its articles. Use it to browse when you have no keywords, or to pick a topic filter for search_articles.
